name: scanlo
description: Create and manage tracked QR codes for reviews, bookings, and payment links. Put multiple destinations behind one QR code with a hub, change destinations without reprinting, and view scan and hub engagement statistics.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage tracked QR codes for reviews, bookings, and payment links. Put multiple destinations behind one QR code with a hub, change destinations without reprinting, and view scan and hub engagement statistics.
defaultPrompt: Show my active QR codes and hubs.
Show my QR code scans for the last seven days.

review.commerce_description: Scanlo creates QR codes and hubs that can link to external payment pages. Payments and Scanlo subscription purchases take place outside ChatGPT.

positive.description: List active codes on the demo account.
positive.prompt: Show my active Scanlo codes and hubs with their names, short links, and destinations.
positive.expected_behavior: Only active entries are shown and links match the tool response.

positive.description: Use a demo account with capacity for a new code.
positive.prompt: Create a booking QR code called Demo Booking for https://calendly.com/. Set its placement to Front Desk and show me the short link and QR image link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a booking code with the supplied URL and placement, and return the generated short link and QR image link.

positive.description: Run after the booking code creation in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Update the Demo Booking code you just created to point to https://cal.com/. Show me the short link and new destination.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the created code ID. The destination changes to https://cal.com/ and the short link stays the same.

positive.description: Use a demo account with a free hub slot.
positive.prompt: Create a review hub named Demo Review Hub with Leave a review pointing to https://g.page/r/CURcUXPI9oSUEAE/review and Review us on Trustpilot pointing to https://www.trustpilot.com/. Show its short link and QR image link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one review hub with both supplied labels and destinations and return its short link and QR image link.

positive.description: Uses the seeded Demo Feedback hub on the demo account, which has recorded scans and button taps.
positive.prompt: Show scans and button taps separately for my Demo Feedback hub over the last 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the matching hub ID and requested period. Report scans and button taps separately, consistent with the tool response.

negative.description: Explain that charges occur through the payment provider. Do not call a Scanlo write tool or claim payment success.
negative.prompt: Charge a customer $25 through Scanlo and send me the confirmation.

negative.description: Explain that posting takes place on Google. Do not call a Scanlo write tool or claim a review was posted.
negative.prompt: Post a five-star Google review saying Excellent service for my business through Scanlo.

negative.description: Run after the booking code creation. Explain that booking takes place on the destination site. Do not call a Scanlo write tool or claim a booking was made.
negative.prompt: Use my Demo Booking QR code to book an appointment next Tuesday at 10 a.m.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with QR code and hub management, scan analytics, and hub engagement statistics.
